rules.name: Block SQL Injection Attempts
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "UNION SELECT") or (http.request.uri.query contains "' OR '1'='1") or (http.request.uri.query contains "DROP TABLE") or (http.request.uri.query contains "--") or (http.request.body contains "UNION SELECT") or (http.request.body contains "DROP TABLE")

rules.name: Block XSS Attempts
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "<script") or (http.request.uri.query contains "javascript:") or (http.request.uri.query contains "onerror=") or (http.request.uri.query contains "onload=") or (http.request.body contains "<script") or (http.request.body contains "javascript:")

rules.name: Block Path Traversal
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "../") or (http.request.uri.path contains "..%2F") or (http.request.uri.path contains "%2e%2e/") or (http.request.uri.path contains "..\\")

rules.name: Block Command Injection
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "; ls") or (http.request.uri.query contains "| cat") or (http.request.uri.query contains "&& whoami") or (http.request.body contains "; ls") or (http.request.body contains "| cat")

rules.name: Block Suspicious User Agents
rules.description: Challenge requests from suspicious user agents
rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap") or (http.user_agent contains "nikto") or (http.user_agent contains "nmap") or (http.user_agent contains "masscan") or (http.user_agent contains "metasploit")

rules.name: Block Known Malicious IPs
rules.description: Block IPs from threat intelligence feeds

rules.name: Block Empty User Agent
rules.description: Block requests with no user agent

custom_rules.name: Log Suspicious Activity
custom_rules.description: Log all suspicious activity for analysis

deployment_instructions.step_1: Navigate to Cloudflare Dashboard > Security > WAF
deployment_instructions.step_3: Enable Managed Rules > OWASP Core Ruleset
deployment_instructions.step_4: Create Custom Rules using expressions above
deployment_instructions.step_10: Fine-tune rules based on false positives
